---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or new capability for Verascope
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What problem does this solve**

Describe the gap or limitation — link to the relevant "Known limitations" bullet in README.md if
this is closing one of the documented ones (e.g. call-graph dependency analysis, a real job queue,
websocket-pushed progress).

**Proposed solution**

What you'd want to see, and roughly how it'd fit into the existing architecture (see README's
"Architecture" section) — doesn't need to be a full design, just enough to discuss.

**Alternatives considered**

Any other approach you thought about and why you didn't prefer it (optional but helpful).

**Would you like to work on this yourself?**

Yes / No — if yes, a maintainer can assign it to you to avoid duplicate work.
